name: Gear Comparison
description: The stat-by-stat difference between a rolled candidate and what is currently equipped in its slot. combat.equipment_slots owns the worn items and their actual bonuses; this reads that state and the candidate's rolled affixes, then publishes named-key deltas, a configurable build-weighted score and which side of the comparison wins each stat. It never equips the candidate and never treats a single item-power number as the decision: a player may value a utility affix or set threshold above raw score. It owns comparison only — no item generation, inventory mutation, tooltip rendering or combat-stat application — so the same result can feed a tooltip, pickup policy or build-analysis screen.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

inputs.name: statWeights
inputs.description: Optional build-specific value per named stat, used only for the advisory score. Missing stats use neutral weight and remain visible as deltas.

inputs.name: lowerIsBetterStats
inputs.description: Named stats for which a reduction is an upgrade, such as cooldown or resource cost. Every other stat treats a positive delta as improvement.

inputs.name: includeSetThresholdDeltas
inputs.description: Whether the comparison reports set pieces gained or lost if the candidate replaces the equipped item. It reads set state and never applies the change.

outputs.name: lastComparison
outputs.description: Candidate, equipped item, slot, per-stat deltas, set-threshold changes and advisory scores.

outputs.name: scoreDelta
outputs.description: Candidate score minus equipped score under the configured weights. Advisory only, never an automatic equip decision.

outputs.name: statDeltas
outputs.description: Candidate minus equipped value for every stat present on either item.

provenance: Added 2026-11-02 for the Diablo loot-and-inventory extraction. Searched equipment and UI ownership first: combat.equipment_slots publishes actual worn bonuses and a single-item bonusesOf query, combat.gear_sets owns set thresholds, and ui.hud renders rather than calculates build deltas. Nothing compares a rolled candidate against the equipped item across all named stats without mutating gear. Library-native; this is an advisory calculation, not an auto-equip rule or tooltip view.
